recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered headshot of a man with short, textured hair, featuring a high-contrast, desaturated sepia color palette. The subject looks directly at the camera with a neutral expression. The background is a blurred, bright horizon line. Typography is placed at the bottom edge, spanning the width of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's eyes as the primary focal point
High contrast between dark hair/clothing and bright background
Horizontal alignment of text against the dark base of the subject's shirt
Warm, muted color temperature across the entire composition
coreInvariants: Tight cropping on the face and shoulders
Text anchored to the bottom horizontal axis

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, large-scale portrait occupying 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down the bridge of the nose to the mouth, then drops to the text at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; limited to the blurred background areas flanking the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige/sepia tones in the skin and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black in the hair, shirt, and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red for secondary text elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones, black, and one accent color

composition.overlap: Placed over the dark shirt area
Placed over the dark shirt area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast through color and tracking; wide-tracked white sans-serif paired with tight-tracked red condensed sans-serif.

avoid: Centering text in the middle of the image

candidateDirections.reason: Clean, geometric sans-serif for the primary name.
Impactful condensed sans-serif for the secondary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, close-up portrait of a man with textured hair, looking directly at the camera. Apply a desaturated sepia-tone filter. The background should be a bright, blown-out horizon line. The bottom 15% of the image should be occupied by a dark, near-black shirt.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two blocks of text on a single horizontal line at the very bottom. The first block in white, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif all-caps. The second block in muted red, tight-tracked condensed sans-serif all-caps.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly desaturated sepia and black?
Is the text positioned at the bottom edge?
Is the lighting high-contrast on the face?
Is the background sufficiently blurred and bright?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the red accent text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Clear, sharp focus on the eyes
Balanced tonal range from deep black to bright highlights

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against the dark shirt
Ensure the sepia tone is consistent across skin and background
Verify the centered symmetry of the headshot
Confirm the all-caps styling of all typography
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast desaturated portrait with a bright, blown-out background and anchor all-caps geometric typography to the bottom edge using a two-color hierarchy.
